SELECT dr.release_id, dr.decision_point_id AS release_decision_point_id, dr.status AS release_status, dr.active_slot, dr.point_version_id, pv.decision_point_id AS point_decision_point_id, pv.status AS point_status, b.binding_id, rv.rule_set_version_id, rv.decision_point_id AS rule_decision_point_id, rv.rule_set_code, rv.status AS rule_version_status, rs.rule_set_id, rs.status AS management_status FROM t_decision_release dr LEFT JOIN t_decision_point_version pv ON pv.point_version_id = dr.point_version_id LEFT JOIN t_decision_point_rule_set b ON b.point_version_id = dr.point_version_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = b.rule_set_version_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code WHERE dr.decision_flow_version_id IS NULL AND (dr.status = 'ACTIVE' OR dr.active_slot IS NOT NULL) AND (dr.decision_point_id IN #{id} OR rs.rule_set_id IN #{id}) ORDER BY dr.release_id, b.binding_id FOR SHARE

SELECT rs.rule_set_id FROM t_decision_release dr JOIN t_decision_flow_node n ON n.flow_version_id = dr.decision_flow_version_id AND n.node_type = 'RULE_SET' JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = n.rule_set_version_id JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code WHERE dr.decision_flow_version_id IS NOT NULL AND (dr.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SHADOWING') OR dr.active_slot IS NOT NULL) AND rs.rule_set_id IN #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_rule_set rs LEFT JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = rs.decision_point_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set_version current ON current.rule_set_version_id = rs.current_rule_set_version_id WHERE rs.status != 'DELETED' AND (dp.point_code = #{pointCode} OR dp.decision_point_id IS NULL) AND rs.rule_set_code = #{ruleSetCode} AND (rs.status != 'CONFIGURABLE' OR dp.decision_point_id IS NULL OR current.rule_set_version_id IS NULL OR current.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'FROZEN') OR current.decision_point_id != rs.decision_point_id OR current.rule_set_code != rs.rule_set_code OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_rule_set_version newer WHERE newer.decision_point_id = rs.decision_point_id AND newer.rule_set_code = rs.rule_set_code AND newer.version_no > current.version_no)) ) + ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rv.decision_point_id, rv.rule_set_code) FROM t_rule_set_version rv LEFT JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code WHERE rs.rule_set_id IS NULL AND (dp.point_code = #{pointCode} OR dp.decision_point_id IS NULL) AND rv.rule_set_code = #{ruleSetCode} )
